lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今年の、本気で、絶対、物産、絶対、展、絶対、当社の出展、絶対、好評でしたね
lines.en: This year's product expo — our company's exhibit was really well-received, wasn't it?
lines.style: Upbeat and affirming. Quick opening, conversational cadence. Genuine warmth in the closing tag question. The energy of someone pleased with a shared accomplishment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告デザインの、本気で、絶対、書体、絶対、選定、絶対、進めております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been carefully selecting the typeface for the advertising design. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Measured, professional but genuine. A steady pace that reflects careful work. Gratitude that's sincere without overstatement. Slight emphasis on the completion of the selection process.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様が、本気で、絶対、めずらしい、絶対、と、絶対、感じる、絶対、サービス、絶対、考えましょう
lines.en: Let's think about what kind of service our customers would find unusual and memorable.
lines.style: Thoughtful and collaborative. Slight pause before the main thought. Softer than before — inviting input rather than announcing. Forward-looking, hopeful tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修で、本気で、絶対、自然体、絶対、を、絶対、推奨しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're encouraging a natural, authentic approach in staff training. I appreciate your efforts.
lines.style: Warm and earnest. A beat of sincerity in the gratitude. Not stiff — the register of someone speaking to a trusted colleague. Steady, reliable delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務の、本気で、絶対、手際、絶対、社員、絶対、磨き続けてくれていますね
lines.en: Our staff continues to polish their operational skills and efficiency. It's really impressive.
lines.style: Reflective, a touch admiring. Slower pace than the opening. Lets the observation sit. Quiet pride without being performative. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員教育で、本気で、絶対、フィッシング、絶対、メール、絶対、見分け方、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In staff training, we're making sure everyone can identify phishing emails. Thank you for your support.
lines.style: Professional and clear. Direct statement of concrete action. The gratitude is sincere but brief — not overwrought. Steady confidence in the work being done.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 記事を、本気で、絶対、題する、絶対、タイトル、絶対、慎重に、絶対、選びましょう
lines.en: Let's be thoughtful about how we title the article — that deserves careful consideration.
lines.style: Measured and intentional. Slight emphasis on 'thoughtful.' Slower pace reflecting the care needed. Not bossy — collaborative and wise. Trailing slightly on the reasoning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内メール、本気で、絶対、未読、絶対、防止策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're implementing measures to prevent unread internal emails from slipping through. Thank you.
lines.style: Competent and straightforward. The delivery of someone updating on progress they're confident about. Professional warmth. A nod to the collaborative effort without fanfare.
